task_title: fleet ops census backup heuristic: board DDL is not a datastore; backup artifacts matched by basename
task_criteria: 1) The patched census reports no check=backup gap for any of these families: 9router, bunker, chimera-v2, coding-hermes-scheduler, doc-writer, duckbrain, eduos.dexdat.com.co, gitreins, hermes-dagger, hivemind-work, mafia-ai-benchmark, musterflow, terminal-jail, trouble, wojons-mythos (all 15 only ever fired on .coding-hermes/board/schema.sql or .gitreins/state.db). 2) A backup/restore artifact is accepted by BASENAME for .md/.sh/.py/.yaml/.yml in addition to whole-component names, so docs/backup-set.md, docs/runbooks/backup-restore.md and scripts/backup-db.sh all clear the finding. 3) Negative control: a fixture tree with migrations/001.sql and no backup/restore/snapshot-named artifact still reports check=backup P1. 4) Second negative control: a fixture tree with .coding-hermes/board/schema.sql AND data.db (or store.db/state.db) still reports check=backup P1, so the harness exclusion cannot swallow a genuine store. 5) Durability: patches/fleet-ops-backup-heuristic.patch applies to the pristine fleet_ops_check.py (sha256 82a3bf3418f1f521e3941334d796e09e1088512eb0f75ddd89d468d36f81d976) and reverses off the patched build (sha256 77d1deb2bd97e61f88b90497590f9d6601003584e380ac9fbc97ccc8d6cd7829); patches/fleet-ops-backup-heuristic.test.py exits 0 on the patched build and non-zero on the pristine build.
